violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed milk (76F) on counter, cut cabbage (50F) in prep top in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Items discarded.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Materials Necessary to Operation
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed hydrogen peroxide, ‘Windex,’ cleaning chemicals stored above food equipment and food preparation areas.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. PIC relocated chemicals to designated storage.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED NO CFM DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PLEASE HAVE ANOTHER PERSON TAKE FOOD SAFETY MANAGER COURSE. A CFM MUST BE PRESENT WHEN KITCHEN IS OPERATING AND MILK/COFFEE IS SERVED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Aids & Devices, Use Restrictions
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SOAP AND A PAPER TOWEL DISPENSER AND HANDWASHING SIGN AT THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Remove the handwashing aids and devices. Food preparation sinks and mop sinks shall not be used for handwashing. SOAP, PAPER TOWELS, AND SIGN MUST BE REMOVED FROM MOP SINK. ALL FOOD PREP MUST BE DONE IN KITCHEN WHERE A HANDSINK IS AVAILABLE FOR USE.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: OBSERVED RAW SHELLED EGGS ON THE COUNTER FROM THE NIGHT PRIOR. AMBIENT ROOM TEMPERATURE WAS ~60F.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. CDI: EGGS DISPOSED OF. EGGS MUST BE KEPT IN THE COOLER.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. OBSERVED RAID INSECTICIDE SPRAY UNDER THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CDI: RAID REMOVED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: IN PREP TOP: CUT CABBAGE AT 55F FOR 3.5HR. ON ICE AT COFFEE STATION: MILK AT 70F FOR 6HR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: ITEMS DISPOSED OF.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: OBSERVED SOUPS IN WALK-IN LABELED 9/10/25, 9/16/25, AND 9/18/25.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CDI: SOUP DISPOSED OF. PLEASE GO THROUGH ALL UNITS ON A REGULAR BASIS TO ENSURE OUT OF DATE ITEMS ARE DISPOSED. OF.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED INSECTICIDE BOTTLE INSIDE FACILITY.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CDI: INSECTICIDE DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: OBSERVED A GAP UNDER THE BACK DOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. PLEASE INSTALL A DOOR SWEEP OR SIMILAR ITEM

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Laundered
violations.observation: OBSERVED SOILED WIPING CLOTHS THROUGHOUT FACILITY.
violations.corrective_action: Cloths in use for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces shall be laundered daily. CDI: SOILED WIPING CLOTHS REMOVED FOR LAUNDERING.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE GREASE TRAP IN NEED OF CLEANING. STRONG ODOR IS PRESENT.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw meat stored over raw lettuce and cooked food in the walk in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC REARRANGED WALK IN COOLER.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: fried chicken 116F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED CHICKEN
